stem: Input EC is stable but root-zone EC rises over several irrigation cycles. Which interpretation is strongest?
choices: Solute accumulation and water-use/delivery balance should be investigated before increasing fertilizer concentration
Stable input EC proves the root zone cannot accumulate salts
Only pH can explain the change
The EC meter should be ignored because the input value did not change
rationale: Root-zone EC can diverge from input EC through concentration, uptake and drainage dynamics. Trends should be interpreted with water balance and substrate conditions.
